output.reason: The cited excerpt on its own is just a metric name [ev-49ff829746c1]. However, it sits in the "Metrics namespace" list, and the heading text for that list [ev-1f419676f177] states the change concretely. In this release, metrics prefixed `cortex_` will start with `loki_` instead, so this metric becomes `loki_prometheus_notifications_latency_seconds_count`. Exposure depends on `metrics_namespace` keeping its default `loki`, since setting it to `cortex` keeps the old names. The obvious consequence is that queries, dashboards or alerts using the `cortex_`-prefixed name stop matching, but the text does not say this outright; the same section also says `metrics_namespace` is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release.
